senses.gloss: भञ्ज् [Perhaps for orig. भ्रञ्ज्; cf. भ्रज्; Lat. frangere, nau-fraga; Germ. brechen; Eng. break.]
2. भञ्ज् (√ 2. भञ्ज्, cl. 10. P. भञ्जयति), ‘to speak’ or ‘to shine’, Dhātup. xxxiii, 86.
भञ्जक mf(इका)n. who or what breaks or divides or destroys, W.
भञ्जक m. a breaker (of doors), Kull.
भञ्जिका f. breaking, plucking (ifc. after the names of plants to denote partic. games; cf. उद्दालक-पुष्प-भ्˚ and शाल-भञ्जिका)
Rubia Munjista, L.
भञ्˚जन mfn. breaking, a breaker, destroyer, dispeller, R.; Kathās. &c.
causing violent pain, Suśr.
भञ्˚जन m. falling to pieces or decay of the teeth (also ˚नक), Suśr.
भञ्˚जन n. breaking, shattering, crushing, destroying, annihilating, frustrating, MBh.; R. &c.
violent pain (अङ्ग-भ्˚), Suśr.
disturbing, interrupting, dispelling, removing, Pañcar.; Mallin. &c.
smoothing (of hair), Viddh.
भञ्˚जना f. explanation, L.
भञ्˚ज˚ना-गिरि m. N. of a mountain g. किंशुलकादि.
भञ्˚जम् See मृणाल-भञ्जम्.
भञ्˚जरु m. a tree growing near a temple, L.
भञ्˚जा f. N. of Durgā, L.
भञ्˚जिन् mfn. breaking, dispelling (see मद-भञ्जिन्).
भञ्˚जी f. See शाल-भञ्जी.
भञ्जिपत्त्रिका f. Salvinia Cucullata, L. (cf. फञ्जि-पत्त्रिका).
